A chart specification

Source: R/arc-chart.R
ArcChart.Rd

Holds a data frame and the mapping built up by the set_*() functions. The @webchart property is computed from that mapping rather than stored, so assigning to it has no effect.

Usage

ArcChart(
  data = NULL,
  chart_type = NA_character_,
  x = NA_character_,
  y = NA_character_,
  stat = NA_character_,
  labs = list(),
  color = list(),
  axes = list(),
  flipped = NA
)

Examples

df <- data.frame(species = c("a", "b", "c"), mass = c(1, 5, 3))

arc_col(df, species, mass)@webchart
